why: The three TechRadar pages are general fitness-tracker and smartwatch guides that never touch golf, so no major reviewer answers the golf-plus-everyday question. The golf-specific sites are golf-GPS rankings whose top picks are $400-$700 or lack heart rate and sleep, and the two pages that do address a hybrid under $300 are affiliate listicles with no verifiable testing (one on a recycled .org domain). Two results are unreadable. A focused page comparing sub-$300 watches on both golf and fitness/sleep with live prices would stand out.
